## Rithm Property Trust Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release


October 13, 2026


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Rithm Property Trust Inc. (NYSE: RPT, “Rithm Property Trust” or the “Company”), an opportunistic commercial real estate investment vehicle externally managed by an affiliate of Rithm Capital Corp., announced today that it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange.


The press release will be available in the Quarterly Results section of Rithm Property Trust’s website:[https://www.rithmpropertytrust.com/financials/quarterly-results/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rithmpropertytrust.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54621629&newsitemid=20261013865821&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rithmpropertytrust.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2Fdefault.aspx&index=1&md5=dfbe2bc62205b880e7dbed27729f806b) .


Rithm Property Trust will not host a conference call to discuss these results. The investor relations team remains available for questions atir@rithmpropertytrust.com .


**About Rithm Property Trust Inc.**


Rithm Property Trust is an opportunistic commercial real estate investment vehicle externally managed by an affiliate of Rithm Capital Corp. (NYSE: RITM). Rithm Property Trust is a Maryland corporation that is organized and conducts its operations to qualify as a real estate investment trust (REIT) for federal income tax purposes.
